subject: ddl: forbid operations that might change system table id in nextgen (#65411)
summary: Reviewed this commit’s DDL-layer changes: introduced `ErrForbiddenDDL` (ddl:8267) and added nextgen-only reserved-ID guards that reject `DROP DATABASE` (reserved DB IDs), `TRUNCATE TABLE`, `ALTER TABLE ... PARTITION BY ...`, and `EXCHANGE PARTITION` when they would involve reserved system table IDs. Verified reserved-ID definition (`pkg/meta/metadef/system.go`) and nextgen system-table creation path (bootstrapped via meta with fixed reserved IDs, not DDL) align with the intent. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata/state-machine handling, compatibility, or consistency within the scoped areas.
